title: Fastener Standards Data: open dimensional data for metric and imperial fastener standards
description:
Open dimensional data for 16 common metric and imperial fastener standards (872 records): DIN 931, DIN 933, DIN 934, DIN 125-A, DIN 127-A, DIN 7980, ISO 4014, ISO 4017, ISO 4032, ISO 7089, ISO 4762, DIN 912, ASME B18.2.1, ASME B18.2.2, ASME B18.3 and ASME B18.21.1.

Each record gives the standard, size, system, grade/finish and nominal dimensions (width across flats, head height, washer bore/outside diameter/thickness) plus mechanical properties where the standard defines them. Distributed as a flat CSV table and the same data as a JSON array. Null values mean the field does not apply to that component, not zero.

Published by Longze Engineering (Hebei Longze Metal Products Manufacturing Co., Ltd.) as the machine-readable version of its public fastener size charts. Nominal values only: each standard defines its own tolerances. Not a normative document - use the standard text for design and acceptance testing.
